module: 'Powertrain' window (Powertrain Inspector) of the live Vehicle Editor. Every frame it asks the vehicle for powertrain.serializeDevicesInfo() (stored in vEditor.powertrainDevices), offers a combo of the devices sorted by name, then displays their jbeam data and live data using powerTrainUtils. Depends on editor_veMain.
notes: Inconsistency: exports `onDeserialize` (without 'd') whereas the extension hook is `onDeserialized`; devicePtr/windowOpen are therefore probably not restored.
The device list is recomputed when vEditor.resetDeviceString is true (vehicle change or editor activation).

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: requests the device info from the vehicle and draws the combo, the jbeam data and the live data.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: On vehicle change, if the editor is active, empties the device list and forces the recomputation of the name list.

onEditorActivated.desc: Called on editor activation: forces the recomputation of the device list.
